resources.string: Honor phones can close apps overnight even with unrestricted battery use. Open Settings › Apps › App launch, find Nocturne, turn off Manage automatically, and turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background. Menu names vary between MagicOS versions, and Nocturne can\'t check these settings for you.

Huawei phones can close apps overnight even with unrestricted battery use. Open Settings › Battery › App launch, find Nocturne, turn off Manage automatically, and turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background. Menu names vary between EMUI versions, and Nocturne can\'t check these settings for you.

Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones can stop apps overnight even with unrestricted battery use. Open Settings › Apps › Manage apps › Nocturne, turn on Autostart, and set Battery saver to No restrictions. Menu names vary between MIUI and HyperOS versions, and Nocturne can\'t check these settings for you.
OPPO, OnePlus and realme battery tips

These phones can stop apps overnight even with unrestricted battery use. Open Settings › Apps › Nocturne › Battery usage and turn on Allow background activity and Allow auto launch. Menu names vary between ColorOS, OxygenOS and realme UI versions, and Nocturne can\'t check these settings for you.

vivo and iQOO phones can stop apps overnight even with unrestricted battery use. Open Settings › Battery › Background power consumption management and allow Nocturne, then turn on Autostart for Nocturne in Settings › Apps. Menu names vary between Funtouch OS and OriginOS versions, and Nocturne can\'t check these settings for you.
Opens your phone\'s own setting if Nocturne can find it, or Nocturne\'s app page if not.
Your BedJet\'s overnight changes come from this phone. Android may pause Nocturne to save battery, and then a change can be missed.
Nocturne only does work in the background around your nights, so this shouldn\'t noticeably shorten your battery life.
Android will ask next. Tap Allow.
